thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated kv-cache paging + continuous-batching error spike in us-west-2. on-call, please respond. thread:2002345678

Elio: Picking this up. I can see kv_cache resident bytes climbing rapidly — from ~14GB to ~88GB in ~8 minutes. paging IOPS spiking and generation p99 climbing.

Marta: That rings a bell we flipped the batching packing change last night. Any config diffs in the scheduler?

Sam: We promoted `batch_scheduler.v2` at 03:10 UTC; it included a new packer fairness heuristic.

Elio: Traces show lots of prefix entries not being evicted; they end up as `pinned=false` but retention policy isn't kicking in due to pack sizing. results in paging thrash + GC churn.

IncidentBot: Suspicion: interaction between continuous-batching packing rules and long-running requests from one customer caused cache blowup and scheduler starvation.

Jia: Confirming: partner traffic pattern changed — handful of sessions with huge context (3k-5k tokens) intermixed with many short requests. packing combined them and created oversized in-flight KV caches.

Aisha: Disk metrics: page_reads/sec 7.5x baseline, disk latency up to 130ms, several pods reported OOM kills.

Cody: Support notes: two enterprise customers in us-west-2 reporting increased 429s and timeouts since ~03:28 UTC. Customer-impacting.

Elio: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable fairness_v2 heuristic, 2) apply per-request KV allocation cap, 3) force-evict large prefix caches on affected pods.

Marta: The flag should be `scheduler.fairness_v2.enabled=false`. Can flip it safely?

Sam: I'm flipping now: `rbctl set scheduler.fairness_v2.enabled=false --cluster=us-west-2` -> in progress.

Elio: Meanwhile I'll hotpatch `batch.max_kv_bytes=5242880` (5MB) and lower the `pack.max_items` to limit pack size.

Marta: Hotpatch `hotpatch-2002-kvcap` applied to canary subset.

Elio: Canary telemetry looks promising. memory trending down, paging back toward baseline. p99 generation dropped from ~2.7s to ~520ms on canaries.

IncidentBot: Mitigation summary: disabled fairness_v2 + set per-request KV cap in us-west-2. Rolling out until metrics stabilize.

Cody: Customers seeing partial recovery. Support has sent initial incident notice.

Jia: Longer-term: revert or adjust packing rule to avoid mixing long with short requests — that was the main starvation vector for short requests.

Sam: I'll prepare rollback for pack_long_with_short flag and add a per-pod packing budget. will wait 30m of stable metrics before rolling globally.

Aisha: Some nodes still show elevated GC churn. issuing `kv_cache.evict --reason=emergency` on those pods helped reclaim memory. running across the affected pool.

Elio: Adding an emergency throttle: any session >2000 tokens will get temporary backpressure to avoid creating new huge KV allocations while recovery is ongoing.

Marta: Timeline capture: incident start ~03:22 UTC, peak impact ~03:35 UTC, mitigations applied ~03:46 UTC, customer visible recoveries ~03:53 UTC.

Cody: I've updated the customer tickets with a timeline and next steps, scheduling deeper sync with customers tomorrow.

Jia: Post-incident actions: 1) change packing heuristic to prefer homogeneous batches (all-short or all-long), 2) enforce hard per-request KV caps in runtime, 3) add paging-rate circuit-breaker per node.

Sam: Created follow-ups: RTE-712 (packing heuristic change + tests), RTE-713 (runtime KV hard caps), RTE-714 (canary monitor improvements).

Aisha: Ops follow-up: add alerts for `kv_cache.active_bytes` and `batch.pack_variance` so we detect this pattern earlier. also add K8s QoS limits for runtime pods to reduce blast radius from OOMs.

Elio: Draft postmortem started: https://redwood.app/pm/INC-2002-draft (will attach traces and logs).

IncidentBot: Handoff: Elio -> Marta for next on-call window.

Elio: handoff to Marta, I'm stepping away for 30m. escalate to @Sam or @Aisha if it regresses.

Marta: I'm primary on this thread now; will monitor for 1h and own postmortem write-up.

Cody: Added notes to support tickets and will prepare customer-facing summary.

Jia: Helpful log snippet correlating pack size to paging:```
[2026-03-15T03:34:07Z] pod=rvd-prod-22 kv_cache.used=80324288000 kv_cache.evictions=5 batch.pack_size=73 request_id=def456 tokens=4210
[2026-03-15T03:34:09Z] pod=rvd-prod-22 page_reads=412 disk_latency_ms=118 p99_gen=2470ms
```

Sam: Include that in the postmortem.

Aisha: Assigning infra action to me: add K8s resource requests/limits for runtime pods and enhance evictor heuristics.

Marta: Thanks all. I'll draft the postmortem skeleton and assign owners for the follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

Elio: final: add an integration test that simulates mixed long/short traffic to prevent regressions.

IncidentBot: Thread closed for now. Will reopen if thresholds trigger. :eyes:
